items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: I just remember his band, but, uh, he was playing at the Palace Theatre.

ctx.x: I just remember his band, but, uh, he was playing at the Palace Theatre. Uh-huh. And at the Lyric Theatre, Mr. Vic Gaffert used to play at the Lyric Theatre. Do you remember that, Hal?
Black Benny on drum. Black Benny on drum. Yeah.

John Orbishow. Oh, yeah. That's what Vic had. Piku, did he have Piku? Piku was playing, uh, Piku and, uh, uh, Kimball. Kimball on trumpet. And his wife was on the piano. Kimball on the piano, that's right. Piano.
